# Vendored search library

MiniSearch **7.2.0**, by Luca Ongaro, MIT licensed.

- Documentation: https://lucaong.github.io/minisearch/
- Source repository: https://github.com/lucaong/minisearch
- ES module: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/minisearch@7.2.0/dist/es/index.js
- License: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/minisearch@7.2.0/LICENSE.txt

The library code is unchanged; the final source-map reference is omitted because
the source map is not bundled. The archive imports the local copy and does not
contact a CDN at runtime. The accompanying `minisearch-LICENSE.txt` retains the
upstream license and copyright notice.
